description: This script configures Quality of Service (QoS) rules and firewall settings on OpenWrt routers, including interface setup, class management, and iptables rule generation.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Adds kernel modules with appropriate insmod command, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds network interface name for a given interface, or exits if not found.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables rules based on matching criteria and options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Handles configuration options for interfaces and rules.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries and sets up interface and class parameters.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns class numbers for QoS classes.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class variables based on configuration.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes QoS settings for a specific network interface.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts QoS setup for all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for a specific QoS class or rule set.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts QoS for a class group, including iptables chain setup.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes firewall rules and modules for QoS.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains.
